checks.title: node2vec p/q transition probabilities match 1/p, 1, 1/q rule
checks.note: p=5 (return penalty), q=2 (outward penalty), matching config.py defaults

checks.title: heavier edge gets proportionally higher walk probability
k-NN: edges are top-k for >=1 endpoint, but the degree cap is NOT strict
checks.note: measured upstream defect: with NODE2VEC_GRAPH_EDGES=50 the same logic can yield degree up to ~2k-1; upstream source gates on the peer's degree (len(result.neighbors(x)) < k) but never on the node's own degree

checks.title: topic description recovers cluster-specific tokens over a shared token
checks.note: rank = cosine(freq vector, one-hot) weighted by log1p(total); the shared high-frequency token is correctly demoted

checks.title: clusters relabelled by descending size (0 = largest)
citation gain analytics: absolute max-gain OK; relative 'hot paper' exceeds 1.0 in first citation year (denominator guard artefact)
checks.note: upstream formula: df[year] / (current_sum + (current_sum == 0)); current_sum is cumulative BEFORE the year, so a paper first cited in year Y gets denominator 1 and rel_gain = raw count. Upstream threshold >=0.01 then always admits such papers, biasing 'hot paper per year' to newly-cited works.
